name: Katalin Illés
description: Katalin Illés is a Web3 and Frontier Tech Product Manager at the UNICEF Office of Innovation. Working with the UNICEF Venture Fund, she leverages blockchain, digital assets, and Digital Public Goods (DPGs) to reshape international development and humanitarian action. Katalin is dedicated to deploying open-source technology to build a transparent, decentralized, and equitable future for the world’s most vulnerable children.
